comment: Gzip bytes a first visit downloads before the app runs (scripts/perf/bundle-report.mjs). Measured 2026-11-13 with `npx vite build` at c157793e3: initial JS 719,611 (one entry chunk), initial CSS 18,996; the limits are about 3% above. CI (after its build) and the push gate fail a build over these; they catch sudden growth, they are not a target. Raise them only on purpose, in the commit that needs it. Raised 2026-11-18 for the memory diagnostics (#612): CI read 724.0 KiB at 22c136833, about 2 KiB above a local build. Raised 2026-11-18 for the native zoom shortcuts (#618): CI read 726.5 KiB on its merge with main. Raised 2026-11-19 for the phone page slide without view transitions (#643): CI read 727.7 KiB on its merge with main. Raised 2026-11-19 for the build tools update (Vite 7, esbuild 0.28): the same sources build an entry 4.0 KiB larger (725.4 to 729.4 KiB in local and gce builds), mostly in the CommonJS packages' wrappers. Raised 2026-11-19 for React Router 7: its router builds an entry 9.0 KiB larger (729.3 to 738.3 KiB in local builds); its production build, which its exports leave out, would save 0.5 KiB. Raised 2026-11-20 for the thread Back loop fix (#691): CI read 742.6 KiB on main after React Router 7, 0.1 KiB under the limit, and 742.7 KiB (760,524 B) on this fix's merge with main. Raised 2026-11-20 for tool markers out of text (#689): CI read 743.3 KiB on main at 18ed47ec1 and 744.2 KiB on this change's merge with it, 0.1 KiB over. What puts the markers back in an agent's text stays in the entry chunk, because the first render reads that text. Raised 2026-11-20 for the phone page slide copying only what shows (#715): CI read 745.8 KiB on this change's merge with main, 0.2 KiB over; the slide runs on the first tap, so its copy stays in the entry chunk. Raised 2026-11-20 for the crash-safe voice recording journal (#714): CI read 747.3 KiB with the journal's roughly 1 KiB in the entry chunk so recovery and cleanup do not depend on a separate download. Raised 2026-11-21 for the startup phase timings in the diagnostics export (#722): CI read 748.3 KiB on main at ce0dcad11, 0.7 KiB over, so every build failed. Raised 2026-11-21 for Needs you first (#733): CI read 749.5 KiB on main at b5571656b, at the limit, and the Safari fallback's anchor choice (cards that kept their order and section) adds about 0.1 KiB to the entry chunk in local builds (745.8 to 745.9 KiB), because the stored section folds are read at sign-out cleanup. Raised 2026-11-21 for the voice recording that follows navigation (#703): CI read 750.3 KiB on main at aabc4e009 and 751.1 KiB on this change's merge with it, 0.1 KiB over. The shell holds the account's one recording (to see it and end it with the account) and the Discard count its reload warning reads, so those stay in the entry chunk; the capture code loads with the composer. Raised 2026-11-21 for matrix-js-sdk 45.1: on its merge with main 1ca370936 a local build's entry is 774.0 KiB (792,614 B) against main's 747.0 KiB (764,972 B), 27,642 B more, and the limit is main's plus that (770,000 B since #703, so 797,700 B), which leaves the room main has under its own. CI then read 779.1 KiB on this change's merge with main at 33797681f, 0.1 KiB over that limit (main grew since 1ca370936), so the limit is CI's reading plus the 0.9 KiB main keeps under its own: 798,700 B. The SDK now matches push rule and invite filter globs with re2js (252 KiB of source in the entry), which its push processor calls synchronously from the client's start, so it cannot load later without a patch; oidc-client-ts (66 KiB of source) left the entry, and the SDK's own code is 87 KiB of source smaller. Raised 2026-11-22 for the Electron desktop shell seam (#750): web CI read 780.3 KiB JS (over 798,700 B) and 19.2 KiB CSS (over 19,600 B) on P1-P3, and a local build with P4 reads 776.0 KiB JS (794,641 B) and 19.2 KiB CSS (19,655 B). The shell hooks (nativeShell, desktopMediaAuth, desktopHistoryButtons, desktopShellLifecycle) and --app-inset-top CSS stay in the entry so they run before the first render and media request; limits are raised to 802,000 B JS and 20,000 B CSS to cover these plus CI's ~2 KiB overhead over local builds.
